note: Hand entries for the venue-declared kind column (README pre-registration of 2026-10-13 02:33Z): sale receipts whose buyer identified itself in a public comment on Subnano. Each entry cites the comment id; the comment's author_kind (the venue's own label) is the value. Tips need no entry here: their label is read from the tip-activities or comments endpoint by receipt-posts.json. The venue's has_purchased flag on a comment says an account bought the post but not which receipt was its purchase, so it never labels a receipt on its own; it is reported as an aside.
